transactions_card_payment_shape.name: transactions_card_payment_shape
transactions_card_payment_shape.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'card_payment' and "transactions"."credit_card_invoice_id" is not null and "transactions"."category_id" is null)
        or ("transactions"."type" <> 'card_payment' and "transactions"."credit_card_invoice_id" is null)

transactions_recurring_shape.name: transactions_recurring_shape
transactions_recurring_shape.value:
("transactions"."recurring_transaction_id" is null and "transactions"."occurrence_date" is null)
        or ("transactions"."recurring_transaction_id" is not null and "transactions"."occurrence_date" is not null and "transactions"."type" in ('income', 'expense'))

transactions_transfer_shape.name: transactions_transfer_shape
transactions_transfer_shape.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' and "transactions"."transfer_id" is not null and "transactions"."transfer_direction" is not null and "transactions"."category_id" is null)
        or ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' and "transactions"."transfer_id" is null and "transactions"."transfer_direction" is null)
